body:
I hope this message finds you well.

We are planning to rent an *Audi Q3 (or similar)* from your *Athens
location* from *Sunday, August 3 to Thursday, August 14, 2025* — a total of
11 days. I would like to confirm a few details before finalizing the
booking.

We would like to register *three drivers* for the rental:


   -

   Myself
   -

   My wife (age 50)
   -

   Our daughter Kyra (age 21), license holder for 2 years 10 months

Could you kindly confirm:


   1.

   Whether all three of us are eligible to be registered as drivers under
   this booking
   2.

   If there are any additional fees or documentation required for the third
   driver
   3.

   Whether cross-border travel to *North Macedonia* is permitted for this
   vehicle/class, and if so, what the insurance and documentation requirements
   are

We’re looking forward to a scenic and comfortable trip across northern
Greece and possibly into North Macedonia, and want to ensure everything is
in order well ahead of time.

Thank you in advance for your help — we greatly appreciate your assistance.

Warm regards,

Mazda Hewitt
